effects.actual_behavior: IAnimatedBoss uses server maxHealth-totalDamageTaken, clamped>=0; setHealth only initializes at tick0 on server, while client delegates. Forge incoming event adds amount after own cap except bypass, armor then magic reduction; accumulates and calls die if resulting health<=0, sets hurtCD30 when configured. This incoming hook precedes downstream success: cancellation/order from external listeners remains pack boundary. Native heal reduces accumulated damage. _td persists float bits XOR1597463007, reload clamps0..maxHP. hurt bypass delegates early; otherwise cap, conditional adaptation multiplier clamp(reducedDamageTicks*.01,.5,amount), rejects FALL/DROWN/IS_FIRE/FREEZE/IN_WALL and too-far current target. Successful hurt resets adaptation30, decrements factor by virtual adaptationFactor and cycles griefing destruction. Factor restores100 after30; DamageTime=max20,factor. Incoming hook clock hurtCD is not itself tested by base hurt. Effects refused by addEffect(instance,entity); fluid push/freeze disabled; fluid travel relative speed, moveSELF then*.8. Idle return260/100 at squared225; spawn position persists, transient clocks do not. Concrete overrides remain separately pending.

Spawn position persists via ints; recovery/transient clocks are not restored.

effects.actual_behavior: Server health multiplier only while current HP equals max HP; remove existing minecraft:hp permanent modifier, install (multiplier-1) ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL if nonzero, fill current max then clamp. Zero amount removes modifier without refill. Status stacking installs amplifier0 initially; existing amplifier below cap adds bonus and replaces duration; at cap it does not refresh. Boss cancelBuffs acts only on Player: food component + active use + config -> cooldown20 and stop; Resistance amplifier>1 -> remove then reapply same duration amplifier0, respecting native effect events. Motion packet only ServerPlayer; addDuringTeleport only ServerLevel. Percent helpers preserve float/Java conversion.

exclusions.reason: Complete declarations and native call/handle census plus pinned base MobEffect.shouldApplyEffectTickThisTick=false establish dormant periodic callbacks, not active bleeding/freezing/teleport/heal semantics. BleedingTick defines two independent random samples (2 damage at p=.5; 3 damage at conditional p=.25; else1); FreezeTick defines p=.05 freeze damage2 and frozenTicks200; Chorus helper defines p=.05 magic3 then 10 same-Y empty-block/support teleport attempts within x/z +/-2, irrespective of hurt result. These do not execute through ordinary effect ticking. Expiry helpers lack registered event/injector/caller bindings. Overgrown is not registered. Registered inert holders retain vanilla duration/display/admission only; consumers outside this JAR remain unknown.

Exact effect registration and inert marker factories: chorus_infection, freeze, bleeding, curse_of_desert and fear have no scheduled native tick payload or independent native consumer beyond admission/delivery/display. Active attribute and gate factories are separately canonical.
